text: Joanna wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen on 4 June 2022, which she described as nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive.
Joanna shared a photo of a Spider-Man poster hanging on her wall, and Nate noticed a Spider-Man pin on Joanna's purse the last time they saw each other.

Joanna says Spider-Man has always been her favourite superhero because of Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person, though Joanna is a fan of any superhero with a rad story and powers.
Nate's top superhero pick is Iron Man, whom Nate admires for his tech and sarcastic humour, and Nate says seeing Iron Man figures makes Nate feel invincible.
Nate keeps a toy Iron Man figure in Nate's room because it reminded Nate of something Nate loves, and Nate says the figure is a good reminder to keep working on Nate's goals.

Joanna's cork board is full of inspiring quotes, pictures and keepsakes, which Joanna calls her little corner of inspiration for motivation and creativity, and Joanna shared a photo of it when Nate asked to see it.
Joanna's cork board has a framed photo of her family, which Joanna hung there because it reminds Joanna of the love and encouragement her family gives her every day.
Nate says family support is invaluable and that good reminders matter, and Joanna says the family photo on the cork board means a lot and keeps Joanna going.
Nate says Nate should start a cork board of Nate's own, and Joanna recommends it but says Nate must be willing to explain what the board is to friends.
Joanna submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest on or just before 24 June 2022, just to see how others might like it.
Nate's gaming party was a great success as of 24 June 2022, and after the party Nate and the guests played chess together just for fun.
Nate gave controller accessories to friends at the gaming party, and most of those friends liked them, although Nate cannot say whether all of them will keep using the accessories.
Seven people attended Nate's gaming party, and six of them said they would want to do it again next month.
Nate made vegan ice cream last Friday (17 June 2022) and shared it with people in Nate's vegan diet group, and Joanna asked for the recipe because it sounded good.
Nate offered to give Joanna the vegan ice cream recipe on 25 June 2022, and Joanna planned to make the ice cream for Joanna's family that weekend.
Joanna says Joanna's family loves it when Joanna makes them new things, and Nate says Nate has no doubt the family will love the ice cream.
Nate won Nate's fourth video game tournament on Friday 8 July 2022, an online event, and Nate says Nate is proud that Nate can make money doing what Nate loves.
Joanna took a road trip for research for Joanna's next movie around the time of Nate's tournament win and visited Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest with lovely scenery and historic buildings.
At the Woodhaven library Joanna found a super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there.
Joanna says Woodhaven has had an interesting past with lots of cool people, and seeing how much the town changed sparked ideas for Joanna's next script.
Joanna's new script is different from Joanna's previous work, and Joanna has started a book, her first attempt at publishing one, with dialogues exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness.
On 10 July 2022 Nate told Joanna that Joanna has so much talent, and Nate said Joanna's readers will recognise Joanna as the author of the movie that got published and love the book even more.
Joanna says writing has become a huge part of Joanna's life, a mix of highs and lows, and that Joanna's journal is pretty much Joanna's rock.
Joanna says writing has become an escape and a way to express Joanna's feelings, and that words have a magical way of healing.
Nate says it is incredible how words can turn something sad into something special, and Nate is glad that writing has worked for Joanna.
In the week of 1 August 2022 someone wrote Joanna a letter after reading an online blog post Joanna made about a hard moment in Joanna's life, saying Joanna's story had brought them comfort.
Joanna says knowing that Joanna's writing can make a difference keeps Joanna going on tough days, and Joanna is glad to have an outlet to share Joanna's stories.
Since Nate and Joanna last spoke, Nate started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts, which Nate says has been fun and rewarding.
Nate's new dairy-free coconut milk ice cream recipe is creamy and rich, and Nate sent the recipe to Joanna on 14 August 2022.
Joanna plans to surprise Joanna's family with a dairy-free dessert made from Nate's recipe, and Nate asked Joanna to let Nate know how it goes.
Nate won an international tournament on 21 August 2022 and says gaming has brought Nate success and lets Nate make a living doing something Nate is passionate about.
Nate's pets got a new, bigger tank, and Nate says the expansion has made them happy and that they are calm, peaceful companions that make coming home after long gaming days better.
In the week of 15 August 2022 Joanna shared a book with Joanna's writers group, was super nervous, and received great feedback on it.
Nate says strong feedback means people are connecting with Joanna's writing, and Joanna celebrated the feedback by making a delicious treat.
Nate planned to take time off on the weekend after 22 August 2022 to chill with Nate's pets, while Joanna planned to relax with a long walk and some reading.
Joanna says taking breaks and looking after herself are important for inspiration and mental health, and that finding balance is all-important when recharging.
When Nate asked for book recommendations, Joanna suggested finding a fantasy book series to read through, because most fiction series are great reads when trying to relax.
Nate recommended a fantasy book series with awesome battles, interesting characters and a plot that rocks, and Nate calls it one of Nate's favourites.
On 22 August 2022 Joanna said Joanna would add Nate's recommended fantasy series to Joanna's reading list and check it out sometime.
Nate's pets are turtles, and Nate said spending time with them has been a big help recently, especially after a letdown in a video game tournament.
Nate had a letdown in a video game tournament shortly before 5 September 2022, which Nate describes as a setback that is part of the learning curve, and Nate is trying to stay positive.
Joanna revised one of Joanna's old recipes and made a cake with strawberries and chocolate, and says tinkering with recipes is helping Joanna find comfort and get creative.
Joanna is experimenting with dessert flavours such as chocolate, raspberry and coconut, and is trying dairy-free options because Joanna is lactose intolerant.

Joanna made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting, says Joanna is making cookies, pies and cakes that suit everyone's diets, and promised to share more of those recipes with Nate soon.
Nate asked to join Joanna in the kitchen, saying baking and cooking bring people together, and Joanna called Nate a fellow chef in the kitchen.
Nate advised that dairy-free margarine or coconut oil can be used instead of butter in baking, and that bakers should check labels to make sure products are dairy-free.
Joanna's laptop crashed in the week of 5 September 2022 and all of Joanna's work was lost, with nothing recoverable, so Joanna now keeps an external drive for backups.
Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on Nate's own cooking show on Monday 12 September 2022, which Nate found nerve-wracking but a blast, and Nate picked up a few new recipes.
Joanna said Joanna will be tuning in to Nate's cooking show and asked Nate for Nate's favourite dish from the show.
Nate's favourite dish from the cooking show is coconut milk ice cream, which Nate describes as smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist and dairy-free for people who cannot have lactose.
Nate's other favourite dairy-free dessert is a dairy-free chocolate mousse, which Nate says is super creamy and tastes like the real thing.
Joanna made a dessert with almond milk on Friday 9 September 2022 and said that dairy-free is a must for Joanna, especially for desserts.
Joanna's favourite dairy-free treat is a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache and fresh raspberries on top.
Joanna's dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries is made with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries, and is Joanna's favourite cake for birthdays and special days.
Joanna shared a dessert recipe made with blueberries, coconut milk and a gluten-free crust, which Joanna described as creamy and delicious.
On 14 September 2022 Joanna asked Nate for the coconut milk ice cream recipe, and Nate agreed to share it and asked Joanna to let Nate know when Joanna makes it.
Joanna tried Joanna's newest dairy-free recipe on 5 October 2022 and it was a winner with Joanna's family, and Joanna says mixing and matching flavours is always fun.
Nate won a really big video game tournament in the week of 26 September 2022 and says Nate still cannot believe how much money Nate made from it.
Nate saved some of the tournament winnings but is not sure what to do with the cash, because Nate is completely content and has no big plans.
Nate says having extra cash means Nate no longer has to stress and can simply enjoy movies and games, and Joanna says extra cash brings a sense of freedom and relaxation.
Nate watched the film 'Little Women' recently and said the acting was awesome and the story was captivating, after Joanna had recommended it to Nate a while back.
Joanna says 'Little Women' explores themes of sisterhood, love and chasing dreams very well, and that the film spoke to Joanna personally.
Joanna finished writing Joanna's book in the week of 26 September 2022 after many late nights and edits, and says Joanna is proud of the finished book.
On 6 October 2022 Nate made Joanna a whiteboard drawing with arrows and words so Joanna can look back on it whenever Joanna needs encouragement.
Nate says encouragement is what got Nate so far in Nate's gaming career, so Nate decided to share that encouragement with Joanna through the whiteboard.
Nate says Joanna's life path is quite inspirational, and Joanna says Joanna will not give up on Joanna's goals as long as Nate keeps supporting Joanna.
Joanna finished a bookmark with a plant on top for one of the ladies at Joanna's writing club, and Joanna says Joanna absolutely loves DIY projects.
Nate went to a game convention on Friday 7 October 2022 and met new people outside Nate's normal circle, which was overwhelming but reminded Nate of the good times gaming can bring.
At the game convention Nate made friends who love games just as Nate does, and they had already planned a gaming session together.
At the convention Nate joined a group playing a board game Nate loves, and the shared hobby helped them bond quickly over having a lot in common.
The group played Catan, which Nate describes as a great strategy game where players build settlements and trade resources.
Nate says Catan can be both competitive and chill, and that Nate does not get crazy competitive over games because gaming is Nate's escape from life's struggles.
Nate suggested that Joanna go to a writing convention, and Joanna said Joanna did not know writing conventions existed and would look into them.
Nate says Nate mostly chills at home after a day, playing video games or watching movies to unwind.
Nate recently watched the movie 'Inception', which blew Nate's mind with its twists and dream elements, and Nate has been playing 'Cyberpunk 2077' nonstop for its futuristic setting and gameplay.
Joanna watched a classic movie recently with a gripping story and great actors, and Joanna rated it 9 or 10 out of 10 because it was amazing.

Nate says movies take Nate to new worlds, fill Nate with emotions and are great for chilling out after a day, and Joanna says movies offer an escape that makes people feel things not normally experienced in life.
Joanna shared a photo of Joanna's living room with a TV and candles, and Nate said the room looked so comfy and that Nate should get a set-up like it.
Joanna advised Nate on making a living room comfy: get a fluffy couch that seats several people so you can lie down, a blanket with a little weight to it, and lights that can be dimmed.
Joanna says Joanna gets super invested in little things like decorating, and thinks it is all worth it when small things make life so much nicer.
On 9 October 2022 Nate said Nate would try Joanna's living-room tips for Nate's own space, and the two of them signed off the chat.
As of 21 October 2022 Joanna had been revising and perfecting a recipe Joanna made for Joanna's family, and it turned out really tasty.
Nate has been stressed about Nate's tournament progress because of tough competitors, but Nate's turtles always cheer Nate up.
Joanna still has a stuffed animal dog that Nate gave Joanna, which Joanna named Tilly, and Joanna keeps Tilly with Joanna while writing because Tilly helps Joanna stay focused.
Joanna named the stuffed dog Tilly after a dog Joanna used to have back in Michigan, which Joanna had to give away after developing an allergy.
Nate is practising for Nate's next video game tournament and says watching Nate's turtles slowly walk around makes Nate happy, though Nate is not sure why.
Joanna had another rejection from a production company around 21 October 2022, and when Nate asked if it was the script sent to a film contest, Joanna confirmed it was.
Nate told Joanna that rejections do not define Joanna and that the perfect opportunity will come, and Joanna said Joanna would keep grinding and moving ahead.
Joanna's movie script that Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on Sunday 23 October 2022, which Joanna called a surreal and satisfying moment.
Joanna said this was the third time one of Joanna's scripts had been shown on the big screen, and seeing the characters and dialogue acted out was Joanna's favourite part.
Joanna's drawings are visuals of Joanna's characters that help bring the characters alive in Joanna's head so Joanna can write them better.
Joanna gets character ideas from people Joanna knows, things Joanna has seen and things Joanna imagines, and says a character takes shape with their own wants, worries and wishes.
Joanna refused to describe the character on the left in a photo and told Nate to watch the movie to find out.
Nate says Nate was already planning to watch Joanna's movie, and talking about it with Joanna made Nate want to watch it even more.
On 25 October 2022 Nate took Nate's turtles out for a walk because Nate was bored, and the turtles were tired afterwards and relaxing in the tank.
Nate's turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruits and insects, and Nate says they get very hyped about fruit such as strawberries.
Nate says Nate's two turtles have different personalities, with one more adventurous and the other more reserved, and Nate enjoys holding them.
Nate says Nate has liked turtles since Nate was a boy and knows all about them, and Joanna said Joanna never knew turtles could be so interesting.
On 4 November 2022 Joanna set up meetings with movie producers and says Joanna is feeling hopeful and inspired about the future.
In the producer meetings Joanna felt confident discussing Joanna's script and vision, and the producers seemed interested and excited, especially by the self-discovery elements in it.
In the week of 24 October 2022 Joanna found old notebooks with Joanna's early writings, and Joanna said it was cool to see how far Joanna has come as a writer.
Joanna's favourite early story is about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway, which Joanna wrote at age 10 and which still inspires Joanna's writing today.
Joanna says turtles make Joanna think of strength and perseverance and help motivate Joanna in tough times, and Nate says turtles' resilience is inspiring.
Nate told Joanna to take courage and keep pushing Joanna's writing forward, calling Joanna's early turtle story a great job of finding passion in writing.
Joanna said Joanna is working on a challenging but fulfilling project apart from the producer meetings, and that the meetings are so exciting.
Nate has been helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament, and Nate says using Nate's skills to make a difference feels good.
Nate made a bowl of coconut milk ice cream on 3 November 2022 and offered some to Joanna, saying it is lactose-free because it was made with coconut milk.
Joanna agreed to visit Nate on Saturday 5 November 2022 and planned to bring some of Joanna's recipes so the two of them could share desserts.
Nate has wanted to try Joanna's chocolate and raspberry cake for a while, and Joanna agreed to bring it along on the visit.
Nate reached the final of a big Valorant tournament on Saturday 5 November 2022 and won, saying it was the best feeling to see Nate's name as champion.
Joanna finished the presentation for producers on Friday 4 November 2022, which Joanna said was tough but looking good.
Joanna said being busy can be tiring but rewarding in the end, and Nate said Nate is grateful to have a job Nate enjoys every day.
Joanna is writing another movie script, a love story with lots of challenges that Joanna hopes to get on the big screen, and the idea for it came from a dream.
Nate remembers when Joanna first started working on these kinds of projects, and Nate says Joanna's dedication is why Joanna does so well in writing.

Joanna submitted a few more scripts in the week of 31 October 2022 and is hoping to hear back soon, expecting a few to be rejected, and Nate said at least one could become Joanna's third published movie.
Nate upgraded equipment in Nate's home gaming setup, a desk with a computer monitor and keyboard where Nate practises and competes and sometimes plays with friends.
Nate says Nate's home gaming setup with two monitors and a laptop is important for Nate's career, because otherwise Nate would never be able to beat Nate's competition.
Nate is currently playing the fantasy RPG 'Xeonoblade Chronicles', which Nate recommends after friends recommended it, and Nate is a big fan of Nintendo games.
Joanna asked whether 'Xeonoblade Chronicles' is a Japanese game series, Nate confirmed it is, and Joanna said it is really cool when a friend's recommendation fits your taste.
Nate says Nate likes the movie recommendations Joanna gives Nate much more than random movies Nate would pick alone.

Joanna finished the intro to Joanna's next movie script and included a handwritten letter from a young man at the beginning, a letter written by Joanna's brother, who used to make Joanna cute notes as kids.
Joanna says the letter from Joanna's brother brings back sweet memories of simpler times, and Nate says childhood memories can be so powerful.
Nate once had a special day taking Nate's pets to the park, where they were amazed, and Nate says mixing new memories with old ones is priceless.
Joanna started writing down some of Joanna's favourite memories, and Nate said Nate will write down what Nate's animals like plus favourite memories with Joanna.
Joanna encouraged Nate to keep writing down fond memories because looking back on them is a blessing, and Joanna urged both of them to keep making great memories and reaching for their dreams.
Nate's game tournament was pushed back in the days before 9 November 2022, so Nate tried cooking and made homemade coconut ice cream, with sprinkles that changed colour.
Nate did not make it to the finals of the last game tournament, which Nate says is okay because Nate will get them next time.
Nate is thinking of joining a new gaming team after the next tourney, having received a few offers but not decided yet, and Nate calls it a big step that Nate is ready for.
On 8 November 2022 Joanna pitched a script to producers, who really liked it, and Joanna says the pitch gave Joanna a big confidence boost and a feeling that Joanna cannot stop writing.
Joanna is working on a new project, a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town, which Joanna describes as a great creative outlet.

Nate creates gaming content for YouTube, which entertains people and satisfies Nate's video game cravings when no tournaments are on, and Nate became inspired because Nate is a big fan of gaming videos.
Joanna advised Nate to watch other people's videos first to learn what the audience likes so that Nate's videos do not flop, and Nate said Nate was already doing that.
Joanna congratulated Nate on starting gaming videos and said Nate will do great, and Nate said Nate is excited to get started even though it is new.
Joanna shared a photo of a sunflower in a field at sunset, taken on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne, and says the surrounding beauty was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
Nate got a third turtle from a pet store after seeing another one there and having to get him, and the tank is now big enough for three turtles.
Joanna was surprised that Nate got a third turtle this year, and Nate says Nate is very happy with the decision and would not have it any other way.
Joanna asked to visit Nate to watch the turtles play from a distance because Joanna is allergic, and Nate said Nate would love to have Joanna over again, perhaps to watch a movie or go to the park.
Nate said Nate would give the turtles a bath before Joanna visits so they are ready to play, and Joanna said Joanna would see Nate the next day, 10 November 2022.
As of 11 November 2022 Joanna was filming Joanna's own movie based on Joanna's road-trip script, and Nate congratulated Joanna and said seeing the script come alive must feel awesome.
Joanna says every day on set is awesome and full of potential, and that being able to show Joanna's vision through the movie is wonderful.
The coolest moment on set for Joanna was when one of the actors told Joanna how much she liked Joanna's script, which gave Joanna chills.
Nate took Nate's turtles to the beach in Tampa on 10 November 2022, which Nate says brings peace in the craziness of life.
Nate says Nate's turtles are calm, do not need much looking after and are great to have around, and Nate loves seeing them soak up the sun on a log in a pond.
Nate says turtles are like zen masters that remind Nate to slow down and appreciate small things, and Nate is experimenting with colourful coconut milk ice cream flavours.
Joanna said Nate's colourful coconut milk ice cream with mix-ins looks really yummy and gives a nice kick, and Nate offered Joanna the recipe to try, which Joanna said she would definitely do.
